Provides access to integrated and national datasets, along with documentation and questionnaires.

returned_title: ISSP – Family and Changing Gender Roles Survey Series
justification: Official data collection for the International Social Survey Programme's specialized family and gender-role surveys. Includes the 2012 and 2022 waves, which directly match the requested decades. Contains survey questions about family organization, marriage, children, household responsibilities, women's employment, and partnership attitudes. Particularly useful for identifying participating countries, comparing survey waves, and obtaining harmonized international datasets.

returned_title: Eurostat – Marriage and Divorce Demographic Statistics Collection (demo_nup)
justification: Official Eurostat metadata and dataset collection describing marriage and divorce statistics. Includes information about marriages by previous marital status, first marriage by age and sex, and divorces by marriage duration. Its geographic scope extends beyond the European Union to countries such as Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Russian Federation, Serbia, and Ukraine, although data availability varies. Particularly valuable for identifying comparable administrative statistics across the full requested country list.

returned_title: European Values Study and World Values Survey – Integrated Values Surveys Data and Documentation
justification: Provides access to harmonized survey datasets and documentation for research on family values and social change across Europe. Particularly valuable for including countries that are not consistently represented in EU-focused datasets, such as Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Russian Federation, and Ukraine. The combined surveys contain observations relevant to the 2010s and 2020s and allow investigation of marriage attitudes, family importance, divorce acceptance, parenthood, and gender norms across diverse European societies.

returned_title: European Values Study (EVS) 2017: Integrated Dataset (2017–2021)
justification: One of the strongest matches for the requested countries and research period. The EVS 2017 wave includes all 38 countries listed in the query, with fieldwork conducted between 2017 and 2021. It provides nationally representative individual-level survey data on political participation, political interest, trust in government and parliament, satisfaction with democracy, political ideology, social tolerance, national identity, and democratic values. The integrated dataset enables systematic cross-national comparisons of political behaviour and attitudes.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS): Rounds 5–11 (2010–2024)
justification: A major cross-national survey providing repeated measurements of political attitudes and behaviour throughout the 2010s and 2020s. Relevant countries include Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Lithuania, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and others, depending on the round. Variables cover voting behaviour, party preferences, political participation, institutional trust, satisfaction with democracy, ideological orientation, immigration attitudes, and political efficacy. Particularly suitable for longitudinal and comparative analyses, although not every requested country participates in every round.

returned_title: World Values Survey (WVS): Wave 6 (2010–2014)
justification: Provides nationally representative survey data on political and social values during the early 2010s. Among the requested countries, Wave 6 includes Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Estonia, Georgia, Germany, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Russian Federation, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and Ukraine. Political variables include democratic legitimacy, confidence in political institutions, electoral participation, political interest, ideological self-placement, protest participation, political trust, and attitudes toward authoritarian government. Particularly valuable for investigating political attitudes in Eastern Europe and the post-Soviet region.

returned_title: World Values Survey (WVS): Wave 7 (2017–2022)
justification: Provides comparative survey data on political attitudes, democratic values, institutional trust, political participation, nationalism, authoritarian preferences, and ideological orientations during the late 2010s and early 2020s. Includes several European and post-Soviet countries relevant to the query. Wave 7 can be combined analytically with Wave 6 to examine changes in political attitudes over time. Country availability must be checked because not all requested countries participated.

returned_title: Joint European Values Study and World Values Survey Dataset (2017–2022)
justification: A harmonized dataset combining the fifth wave of the European Values Study with the seventh wave of the World Values Survey. It is particularly relevant because the EVS component covers all 38 requested countries. The dataset provides internationally comparable measures of political trust, democratic attitudes, political interest, social values, national identity, institutional legitimacy, and political participation. Particularly useful for comparing European political behaviour with broader international patterns using harmonized variables.

returned_title: World Values Survey: Longitudinal Time-Series Dataset (1981–2022)
justification: Combines multiple World Values Survey waves into a longitudinal cross-national dataset, including the 2010–2014 and 2017–2022 survey periods. Provides repeated observations of political attitudes across participating countries, including several from the requested European and post-Soviet region. Relevant indicators include confidence in government, satisfaction with political institutions, support for democracy, political participation, tolerance, ideology, and national identity. Useful for investigating changes in political culture over time.

returned_title: Integrated Values Surveys (IVS): EVS and WVS Trend Data (1981–2022)
justification: Provides a framework for combining the European Values Study trend file and the World Values Survey longitudinal dataset. Particularly valuable for constructing a broad cross-national dataset covering the requested countries during the 2010s and 2020s. Measures include political engagement, democratic legitimacy, confidence in political institutions, ideological identification, civic participation, and social attitudes. The combined coverage is particularly useful for comparing Western Europe, Central and Eastern Europe, the Balkans, and post-Soviet countries.

returned_title: European Values Study: Data and Documentation Archive
justification: Official research data archive providing access to integrated and country-specific European Values Study datasets. Particularly relevant for locating the EVS 2017–2021 observations covering all 38 requested countries, including Albania, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Russian Federation, Ukraine, and Latvia. Contains survey data and documentation on political values, democracy, institutional trust, citizenship, political engagement, national identity, and social attitudes. Supports both pooled cross-national analysis and country-level research.

returned_title: Comparative Study of Electoral Systems (CSES): Module 4 (2011–2016)
justification: International comparative electoral survey dataset focusing on voter behaviour and political attitudes around national elections. Module 4 covers elections conducted between 2011 and 2016 and includes participating European countries. Relevant variables include reported voting behaviour, party choice, political knowledge, electoral participation, perceptions of government performance, party identification, ideological positioning, and political representation. Particularly useful for analysing electoral behaviour during the 2010s. Coverage varies by participating election study.

returned_title: Comparative Study of Electoral Systems (CSES): Module 5 (2016–2021)
justification: Highly relevant comparative dataset on electoral behaviour, political attitudes, and democratic representation during the late 2010s and early 2020s. It contains individual-level post-election survey data from participating countries, including European democracies. Module 5 emphasizes attitudes toward political elites, populism, political outsiders, democratic institutions, and electoral participation. Variables also cover voting choices, ideological preferences, political trust, and satisfaction with democracy. Particularly useful for comparative research on populism and electoral politics.

returned_title: Comparative Study of Electoral Systems (CSES): Integrated Module Dataset
justification: Combines and harmonizes multiple CSES election-study modules, enabling longitudinal comparisons of voting behaviour and political attitudes. The dataset is relevant for studying political participation, party preferences, democratic satisfaction, electoral accountability, and ideological positioning across participating European countries. Its integrated structure facilitates comparisons between elections in the early 2010s and those conducted in the late 2010s and early 2020s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Citizenship II (2014)
justification: Cross-national survey focusing on citizenship, democratic participation, political engagement, and civic responsibilities. The 2014 module contains data from participating European countries relevant to the query. Variables include voting, political participation, protest activity, political interest, institutional trust, perceptions of citizenship duties, democratic rights, and political efficacy. Particularly suitable for examining differences in political participation and civic norms across European societies during the 2010s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): Role of Government V (2016)
justification: Comparative survey dataset examining citizens' expectations of government and attitudes toward state intervention. Includes participating European countries and provides measures of trust in government, attitudes toward public spending, government responsibilities, political ideology, civil liberties, and perceptions of state authority. Particularly useful for comparing political attitudes toward government across different European political systems in the mid-2010s.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP): National Identity III (2013)
justification: Provides internationally comparable survey data on national identity, patriotism, nationalism, immigration attitudes, and national belonging. Includes participating European countries during the 2010s. Relevant to political attitudes because national identity and perceptions of immigration are important dimensions of political ideology, electoral preferences, and support for nationalist political movements. Particularly useful for comparing Western, Central, and Eastern European attitudes.

returned_title: Caucasus Barometer: Cross-National Survey Data (2010–2024)
justification: Especially relevant for Armenia, Azerbaijan, and Georgia, which are not consistently represented in major Western European survey programmes. Provides nationally representative data on political trust, democratic attitudes, electoral participation, political interest, government performance, institutional confidence, and geopolitical preferences. Available time-series data cover Armenia and Georgia through 2024 and Azerbaijan through 2013. Particularly useful for studying political developments in the South Caucasus during the 2010s and 2020s.

returned_title: Caucasus Barometer: Armenia Time-Series Dataset (2008–2024)
justification: Provides repeated nationally representative survey observations for Armenia, including multiple waves during the 2010s and 2020s. Contains indicators of political participation, confidence in political institutions, trust in parliament, attitudes toward democracy, perceptions of government performance, and geopolitical orientations. Particularly useful for analysing changes in Armenian political attitudes before and after the political transformations of 2018.

returned_title: Caucasus Barometer: Georgia Time-Series Dataset (2008–2024)
justification: Provides longitudinal survey data on political behaviour and attitudes in Georgia throughout the requested period. Measures political trust, democratic preferences, institutional legitimacy, electoral engagement, political satisfaction, and attitudes toward domestic and international institutions. Particularly useful for studying changes in democratic attitudes, political polarization, and public confidence in Georgian institutions.

returned_title: Caucasus Barometer: Azerbaijan Time-Series Dataset (2008–2013)
justification: Provides nationally representative survey data for Azerbaijan covering the early 2010s. Includes political trust, institutional confidence, attitudes toward governance, democratic values, and political engagement. Particularly relevant because comparable individual-level political attitudes data for Azerbaijan are less widely available than for many European countries. The available time series ends in 2013, so this dataset does not cover the 2020s.

returned_title: EBRD Life in Transition Survey II (2010)
justification: Large-scale cross-national household survey conducted in 2010 across transition economies and comparison countries. Covers numerous countries in the query, particularly Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Estonia, Georgia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Romania, Russian Federation, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, and Ukraine. Measures include institutional trust, perceptions of corruption, satisfaction with government, political and economic preferences, and attitudes toward democratic institutions. Provides an important baseline for the 2010s.

returned_title: EBRD Life in Transition Survey III (2016)
justification: Cross-national survey conducted in 2016 across 31 EBRD economies and two comparator countries, Germany and Italy. Includes many requested Central and Eastern European, Balkan, and post-Soviet countries. Contains individual-level information on trust in public institutions, perceptions of corruption, satisfaction with government, attitudes toward democracy, economic inequality, and public services. Particularly useful for analysing how economic and social conditions relate to political attitudes during the mid-2010s.

returned_title: EBRD Life in Transition Survey IV (2022–2023)
justification: Provides harmonized household survey data from 2022–2023 across 33 EBRD economies and four comparator economies. Relevant for investigating political attitudes and institutional confidence in Central and Eastern Europe, the Balkans, and parts of the post-Soviet region during the 2020s. Includes measures of trust, perceptions of governance, satisfaction with institutions, economic insecurity, and social attitudes. Particularly valuable when combined with the 2010 and 2016 Life in Transition Surveys to examine changes over time.

returned_title: EBRD Life in Transition Surveys: Integrated Cross-Wave Research Collection (2010, 2016, 2022–2023)
justification: Official collection providing access to multiple comparable Life in Transition Survey waves, including data files, questionnaires, and technical documentation. Particularly useful for researchers constructing repeated cross-sectional datasets on political attitudes across Eastern Europe, the Western Balkans, and the Caucasus. Enables analysis of changes in institutional trust, perceptions of political governance, corruption, government performance, and attitudes toward democracy between 2010 and the early 2020s. Country coverage and questionnaire comparability should be checked across waves.

returned_title: European Values Study (EVS) 2017 – Integrated Dataset
justification: One of the most relevant datasets for this query. Contains nationally representative survey data on gender roles, family values, marriage, women's employment, gender equality, and traditional versus egalitarian attitudes. Covers all 37 requested countries, including Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, the Russian Federation, Ukraine, and Latvia. Fieldwork was conducted primarily between 2017 and 2021. Particularly suitable for comparing gender-role attitudes across European countries during the late 2010s and early 2020s.

returned_title: Joint European Values Study and World Values Survey (EVS/WVS) 2017–2022 Dataset
justification: A harmonized cross-national dataset combining the European Values Study and World Values Survey. Includes questions concerning gender equality, women's political leadership, employment opportunities, education, marriage, family responsibilities, and traditional gender norms. Provides coverage of all requested countries through the combined surveys, although survey years vary by country. Especially useful for studying differences between Western, Northern, Central, Eastern, and Southeastern Europe.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) 2022 – Family and Changing Gender Roles V
justification: A highly relevant dataset specifically designed to investigate gender roles and family relationships. Includes questions about women's employment, attitudes toward working mothers, traditional household responsibilities, childcare, parental leave, division of unpaid domestic labor, and gender stereotypes concerning leadership. Data were collected between 2021 and 2024. Includes numerous requested countries, such as Austria, Bulgaria, Switzerland, Czech Republic, Germany, Denmark, Finland, France, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Lithuania, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Slovenia, and Slovakia. Particularly valuable for examining contemporary gender-role attitudes and comparing them with earlier ISSP waves.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) 2012 – Family and Changing Gender Roles IV
justification: Cross-national survey focusing specifically on changing gender roles, family structures, women's employment, household labor, childcare, and attitudes toward marriage and parenting. Includes participating European countries from the requested list. Provides an important early-2010s baseline for comparison with the ISSP 2022 Family and Changing Gender Roles V dataset. Particularly useful for studying how traditional and egalitarian attitudes evolved over approximately a decade.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS) – Cumulative Survey Data, 2010–2024
justification: Large-scale cross-national survey providing repeated measurements of European social attitudes, beliefs, and behaviors. Relevant variables include gender, employment, family circumstances, discrimination, political participation, social values, and attitudes toward equality. Covers many requested countries, including Albania, Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Great Britain, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Lithuania, Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, and Ukraine, depending on the survey round. Particularly useful for longitudinal comparisons throughout the 2010s and 2020s.

returned_title: European Social Survey Round 11 (2023–2024) – Gender in Contemporary Europe: Rethinking Equality and the Backlash
justification: Especially relevant because Round 11 includes a dedicated module examining gender attitudes and contemporary debates about equality. Topics include gender stereotypes, attitudes toward gender equality, perceptions of discrimination, and changing expectations concerning women's and men's social roles. Data were collected in 2023–2024 across participating European countries. The data builder allows researchers to select individual countries and gender-related variables. An excellent source for examining gender-role attitudes during the 2020s.

returned_title: World Values Survey (WVS) Wave 7 – Cross-National Dataset, 2017–2022
justification: International survey dataset measuring values, social norms, and attitudes toward gender equality. Relevant questions address whether men make better political leaders, whether university education is more important for boys, whether men should receive priority in employment, and whether working mothers can maintain good relationships with their children. Includes several requested countries, such as Armenia, Czech Republic, Germany, Great Britain, Netherlands, Romania, Russian Federation, Serbia, Slovakia, and Ukraine. Complements the European Values Study and is useful for studying gender stereotypes in the late 2010s and early 2020s.

returned_title: European Values Study – Longitudinal and Historical Survey Datasets
justification: Provides access to multiple European Values Study waves and longitudinal datasets, enabling comparisons of gender-role attitudes over time. Relevant variables examine traditional family structures, women's participation in the workforce, marriage, parenting, and gender equality. Includes extensive coverage of the requested European countries. Particularly valuable for contextualizing the 2017–2021 observations against earlier survey waves and investigating long-term changes in gender norms.

returned_title: European Institute for Gender Equality (EIGE) – Gender Statistics Database
justification: Comprehensive European database containing sex-disaggregated statistics on gender equality, employment, earnings, education, political representation, unpaid care work, household responsibilities, and gender-based violence. Particularly useful for EU member states in the requested list, including Austria, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, and Sweden. Includes historical observations from the 2010s and 2020s, depending on the indicator. Best suited for measuring actual gender inequalities rather than personal attitudes.

returned_title: World Bank – Gender Data Portal
justification: Comprehensive international database providing gender-disaggregated statistics across all requested countries. Contains indicators relating to women's labor force participation, education, entrepreneurship, political representation, economic opportunities, health, and household characteristics. Provides historical time series covering the 2010s and 2020s, although availability varies by indicator and country. Particularly valuable because it includes EU and non-EU countries, allowing comparisons between Western Europe, the Western Balkans, the South Caucasus, and Eastern Europe.

returned_title: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE) – Gender Statistics Database
justification: Official international statistical resource focused on gender differences across European and neighboring countries. Relevant topics include women's economic participation, education, family and household characteristics, political representation, demographic patterns, and gender inequalities. Particularly useful because UNECE covers the broader European region, including Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, the Russian Federation, Serbia, Switzerland, Ukraine, and EU countries. Supports comparative analyses during the 2010s and 2020s.

returned_title: UNECE Statistical Database – Gender and Demographic Overview by Sex, Country, and Year
justification: Directly accessible statistical dataset providing gender-related demographic indicators organized by sex, country, and year. Includes the requested countries within the UNECE region. Allows users to select specific indicators and years, including observations from the 2010s and 2020s where available. Useful for constructing comparative country-year datasets and examining differences between women and men in demographic and socioeconomic outcomes.

returned_title: OECD – Social Institutions and Gender Index (SIGI)
justification: Cross-country dataset measuring discrimination against women embedded in social institutions, formal and informal rules, and social norms. Relevant dimensions include discrimination within families, restrictions on physical integrity, access to productive and financial resources, and restrictions on civil liberties. Includes European and neighboring countries from the requested list. Historical editions, including 2014, 2019, and 2023, make it useful for examining changes in institutional gender inequality during the 2010s and 2020s.

returned_title: OECD – Social Institutions and Gender Index (SIGI) Dashboard and Country Data
justification: Interactive database covering discriminatory gender norms and institutions across 179 countries. Includes indicators concerning family responsibilities, gender discrimination, economic empowerment, and women's rights. Particularly suitable for comparing countries in Western Europe, Eastern Europe, the Western Balkans, and the South Caucasus. The dashboard provides access to country profiles and comparative measures that complement individual-level survey data on gender attitudes.

returned_title: OECD Data Explorer – Gender Equality and Social Institutions Data
justification: Statistical platform containing OECD gender equality indicators and historical Social Institutions and Gender Index data. Relevant topics include labor market gender gaps, employment, education, unpaid work, family responsibilities, and institutional discrimination. Historical SIGI editions include 2012, 2014, 2019, and 2023. Particularly useful for comparing gender equality outcomes over time and integrating institutional measures with survey-based indicators of gender-role attitudes. Country coverage varies across datasets.

returned_title: United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) – Gender Social Norms Index (GSNI)
justification: Highly relevant dataset measuring gender biases in social attitudes toward women and men. Based on questions concerning women's political leadership, educational opportunities, economic participation, and personal autonomy. The 2023 index uses World Values Survey observations from the 2010s and early 2020s. Includes a selection of the requested countries, depending on survey availability. Particularly valuable for comparing the prevalence of discriminatory gender beliefs across countries.

returned_title: UNDP – 2023 Gender Social Norms Index Dataset
justification: Specific edition of the Gender Social Norms Index providing country-level measures of gender prejudice. Uses World Values Survey data from waves covering 2005–2022, including observations from 2010–2014 and 2017–2022. Measures biases concerning women's capabilities and rights in political, economic, educational, and personal domains. Useful for analyzing differences in traditional gender stereotypes across participating European countries and identifying changes between survey periods.

returned_title: Eurostat – Harmonised European Time Use Statistics: Time Spent in Activities by Sex and Employment Status
justification: Relevant dataset for studying the practical division of gender roles through time-use behavior. Provides statistics on how women and men allocate time to different activities, including paid employment and unpaid household or care responsibilities. The linked dataset belongs to the newer European time-use data collection covering the 2020s. Particularly useful for investigating whether traditional gender divisions persist in everyday life. Geographic coverage is concentrated on participating European countries, and observations are not available for every requested country.

returned_title: World Bank Gender Data Portal – Gender Data Availability by Country, Topic, and Year
justification: Interactive resource showing which gender-related indicators are available for individual countries and periods. Covers more than 1,000 indicators and allows exploration of data availability by country, topic, and year. Includes all requested countries, making it particularly useful for identifying comparable indicators covering the 2010s and 2020s. Helps researchers assess missing data before selecting measures of gender inequality, employment, education, political participation, and family-related outcomes.

returned_title: International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) – Data Download Archive
justification: Official access point for internationally harmonized survey datasets, including the 2012 and 2022 Family and Changing Gender Roles modules. The archive also provides other ISSP modules containing information on work, social inequality, family relationships, and attitudes toward social institutions. Useful for identifying additional gender-related variables and constructing comparisons between the 2010s and 2020s. Participating countries vary by survey wave, so geographic coverage must be checked for each dataset.

returned_title: European Social Survey – Multilevel Data
justification: Research dataset designed to facilitate the analysis of European Social Survey respondents alongside contextual information about the countries and societies in which they live. Useful for examining how individual gender attitudes relate to broader national social, economic, and institutional conditions. Includes multiple ESS rounds from the 2010s and 2020s, with geographic coverage depending on participation. Particularly suitable for multilevel statistical models investigating cross-national differences in gender roles.

returned_title: European Values Study 2017 – Country Participation, Fieldwork, and Integrated Dataset Documentation
justification: Official documentation and dataset access resource for the fifth wave of the European Values Study. Particularly valuable for this query because it documents participation and survey fieldwork across all 37 requested countries. Provides country-specific survey periods, sample sizes, collection methods, and access to the harmonized dataset. Essential for evaluating comparability when analyzing gender-role attitudes across countries surveyed in different years between 2017 and 2021.

returned_title: European Environment Agency (EEA) – Europe's Environment 2025: Country Environmental Indicators
justification: Highly relevant cross-country environmental dataset providing downloadable CSV files for 20 environmental indicators across EEA member and cooperating countries. Covers environmental protection expenditure, waste generation, and other environmental conditions. Includes many of the requested European countries, with historical observations from the 2010s and 2020s. Particularly useful for comparative analysis of environmental conservation policies and outcomes.

returned_title: European Environment Agency – European Air Quality Data (2013–Present)
justification: Provides verified and regularly updated air pollution measurements from monitoring stations across Europe, beginning in 2013. Includes concentrations of major atmospheric pollutants such as PM2.5, PM10, nitrogen dioxide, and ozone. Particularly relevant for investigating environmental quality, pollution trends, and the effectiveness of air quality regulations during the 2010s and 2020s. Geographic coverage includes numerous EU and non-EU European countries.

returned_title: European Environment Agency – European Air Quality Interpolated Data (2006–2025)
justification: Provides geographically interpolated annual air pollution concentration datasets covering Europe, including the entire 2010s and much of the 2020s. Spatial datasets are available in GeoTIFF format, supporting GIS analysis and the examination of pollution exposure across national boundaries. Useful for comparing environmental conditions between countries and investigating spatial patterns of air pollution.

returned_title: Eurostat – Environment Statistics Database
justification: Comprehensive European environmental statistics covering waste management, water resources, environmental protection expenditure, biodiversity, forests, and environmental accounts. Includes annual observations throughout the 2010s and 2020s for EU member states and selected neighboring countries. Particularly useful for comparing environmental policy implementation, conservation investment, and resource management between European countries.

returned_title: Eurostat – Air Pollutants by Source Sector
justification: Country-level dataset documenting emissions of major air pollutants by economic sector. Historical coverage extends from 1980 to 2024, encompassing both requested decades. Enables comparisons of industrial, agricultural, transport, and other emission sources across European countries. Useful for studying pollution reduction strategies and environmental regulatory performance.

returned_title: United Nations Statistics Division – Environment Statistics Country Files
justification: Contains national environmental statistics submitted through the UNSD/UNEP Questionnaire on Environment Statistics. Focuses particularly on water resources and waste management, with information from multiple reporting cycles spanning the 2010s and 2020s. Especially valuable for supplementing Eurostat data with information from non-EU countries such as Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Ukraine, and the Russian Federation, subject to reporting availability.

returned_title: United Nations Statistics Division – Environment Statistics Country Snapshots
justification: Provides internationally comparable national environmental indicators covering biodiversity, energy, waste management, and other environmental topics. Includes country profiles for European and neighboring states. Useful for comparing conservation conditions and environmental pressures across countries with different statistical reporting systems. Historical coverage varies by indicator.

returned_title: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe – Statistical Database
justification: Regional statistical database covering European countries and countries in the Caucasus and Eastern Europe. Provides country-level and time-series statistics, including environmental and sustainable development indicators. Particularly relevant because the requested countries include both EU members and non-EU states such as Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, the Russian Federation, Serbia, and Ukraine. Supports cross-country comparisons during the 2010s and 2020s.

returned_title: Yale Environmental Performance Index – Historical and Current Environmental Performance Datasets
justification: Provides downloadable Environmental Performance Index scores, rankings, underlying indicators, and historical editions. Covers environmental health, biodiversity conservation, ecosystem vitality, climate mitigation, air pollution, forests, fisheries, and waste management. Particularly suitable for comparing environmental performance among all or most of the requested countries. Historical editions from the 2010s and 2020s allow comparisons over time, although methodological differences between editions require consideration.

returned_title: 2024 Environmental Performance Index – Country Environmental Performance Scores
justification: Provides environmental performance scores and ten-year performance changes for countries worldwide, including Albania, Armenia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Hungary, Iceland, Italy, Lithuania, Montenegro, Netherlands, North Macedonia, Norway, Poland, Romania, Russia, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Sweden, Spain, Switzerland, Portugal, Ukraine, Latvia, and the United Kingdom. Combines 58 indicators across 11 environmental categories, making it particularly valuable for comprehensive comparative environmental research.

returned_title: 2024 Environmental Performance Index – Ecosystem Vitality
justification: Country-level dataset measuring ecosystem preservation and environmental sustainability. Includes biodiversity and habitat protection, forests, fisheries, agriculture, air pollution, and water resources. Reports environmental performance scores and ten-year changes, providing insights into environmental conservation trends from approximately the mid-2010s through the 2020s. Particularly relevant for assessing conservation effectiveness across the requested countries.

returned_title: 2024 Environmental Performance Index – Red List Index
justification: Provides country-level indicators related to the extinction risk of species. Includes numerous requested European countries and ten-year changes in conservation-related performance. Particularly suitable for studying biodiversity protection, species conservation, and changes in extinction risk. Can be combined with protected-area and species-occurrence data to investigate biodiversity conservation outcomes.

returned_title: 2024 Environmental Performance Index – Species Protection Index
justification: Focuses on the effectiveness of biodiversity protection through conservation coverage of species. Provides comparable country-level environmental conservation scores, including data for European countries. Useful for assessing whether national protected-area systems adequately represent biodiversity and for comparing conservation effectiveness between countries during the 2020s.

returned_title: 2024 Environmental Performance Index – Protected Human Land
justification: Provides internationally comparable country-level indicators of terrestrial conservation protection. Relevant for examining the extent to which countries protect land affected by human activity. Particularly useful for comparative research on protected areas, habitat conservation, and national biodiversity strategies across European countries.

returned_title: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN – World Database on Protected Areas (WDPA)
justification: One of the most relevant global datasets for conservation research. Contains spatial and descriptive information about terrestrial and marine protected areas, including national parks, nature reserves, and other legally designated conservation areas. Covers the requested countries, including non-EU European states and the Caucasus. Updated monthly, with information on protected-area designations that can support research on conservation expansion during the 2010s and 2020s. Particularly useful for GIS analysis and comparisons of protected-area coverage.

returned_title: Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) – Species Occurrence Records
justification: Global biodiversity database containing georeferenced species observations collected from scientific institutions, monitoring programs, museums, and citizen-science platforms. Researchers can filter records by country, species, and observation year, including 2010–2026. Provides extensive biodiversity observations across Europe, the Caucasus, and Russia. Particularly valuable for investigating changes in species distribution, biodiversity monitoring, conservation priorities, and ecological conditions during the requested decades.

returned_title: Global Biodiversity Information Facility – Occurrence Data API
justification: Provides programmatic access to biodiversity occurrence datasets, including species observations, coordinates, collection dates, and taxonomic information. Supports constructing customized biodiversity datasets for all requested countries using geographic and temporal filters. Particularly useful for large-scale comparative biodiversity research covering the 2010s and 2020s. This is the official API documentation and access point rather than a standalone dataset.

returned_title: Global Forest Watch – Forest Monitoring and Environmental Data
justification: Provides access to forest-related datasets through the Global Forest Watch data infrastructure. Relevant variables include forest-cover change and other measures of forest conditions, depending on the selected dataset. Particularly useful for studying deforestation, forest conservation, habitat fragmentation, and land-use pressures across European countries, Russia, and the Caucasus. Historical forest-change datasets support comparisons across the 2010s and 2020s. The URL is the official data API documentation.

returned_title: Our World in Data – Annual CO2 Emissions by Country
justification: Provides annual territorial carbon dioxide emissions for countries worldwide, with historical observations extending from 1750 through 2025. Includes the requested countries, generally represented using internationally standardized country names. Particularly useful for examining climate-related environmental pressures, changes in national emissions, and the effectiveness of emissions reduction efforts throughout the 2010s and 2020s. Data can be downloaded and used for longitudinal cross-country analysis.

returned_title: 2024 Environmental Performance Index – Environmental Health
justification: Provides country-level environmental health performance scores, including data for Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Georgia, North Macedonia, and Serbia, alongside other requested countries. Captures environmental conditions relevant to human health, including pollution-related risks. The dataset includes ten-year performance changes, making it useful for investigating environmental improvements and persistent pollution challenges across the region.

returned_title: European Environment Agency – Air Quality Annual Statistics
justification: Provides annual air pollution statistics for European monitoring stations, covering pollutants regulated under European air quality legislation. Supports examination of changes in pollution exposure, air quality standards, and environmental conditions during the 2010s and 2020s. Particularly useful for comparing urban and national air quality and identifying pollution trends relevant to environmental conservation and public health.

returned_title: 2026 Environmental Performance Index – Country Scores, Trends, Rankings, and Raw Environmental Data
justification: Provides the 2026 edition of the Environmental Performance Index, including downloadable country scores, historical trends, rankings, individual indicator scores, and underlying raw data. Covers numerous environmental dimensions, including biodiversity conservation, ecosystem conditions, pollution, climate change, and environmental health. Suitable for examining environmental conditions and conservation performance in the 2020s and comparing them with historical EPI editions from the 2010s. Particularly useful for creating a harmonized comparative research framework across the requested countries.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 101.3 (2024)
justification: Highly relevant cross-national survey dataset collected between April and May 2024. Explicitly classified under 'Cultural and national identity' by GESIS. Covers all 27 EU member states, including Belgium, Bulgaria, Czech Republic, Denmark, Germany, Estonia, Ireland, Greece, Spain, France, Italy, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Hungary, Malta, Netherlands, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Finland, Sweden, and Croatia. Useful for examining national identity, European identification, citizenship, and attitudes toward European integration.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 101.2 (2024)
justification: Cross-national Eurobarometer survey from 2024 with information relevant to European identity, political attitudes, and citizenship. Particularly useful because its geographic classifications include EU member states alongside the United Kingdom, Turkey, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia, Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, and Moldova. Check the questionnaire and country-specific observations to establish which countries are represented in the released data.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 101.4 (2024)
justification: European public opinion survey conducted in 2024. Provides comparative information on attitudes toward European institutions, society, and integration. Relevant for investigating relationships between national belonging, European identity, and political attitudes across EU countries. The GESIS landing page provides access to dataset documentation and questionnaire information.

returned_title: Standard Eurobarometer 104: European Citizenship (Autumn 2025)
justification: Especially relevant to the requested geographic scope and period. Conducted between October 9 and November 5, 2025, across 38 countries and territories. Covers all 27 EU member states, Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, Turkey, Kosovo, the United Kingdom, and the Turkish Cypriot community. Focuses on European citizenship, European identity, integration, and enlargement. The linked official publication provides access to survey findings and documentation.

returned_title: Special Eurobarometer 508: Values and Identities of European Citizens (2020)
justification: Directly addresses cultural, national, and European identity during the 2020s. Conducted in October–November 2020, the survey investigates how European citizens understand their identities, shared values, and sense of belonging. Particularly suitable for comparing national and European identification across the 27 EU member states. It provides a valuable baseline for examining changes in collective identity during the decade.

returned_title: European Social Survey: Round 11 (2023/2024)
justification: Major comparative social survey containing measures of national, European, and ethnic identity, perceived discrimination, immigration attitudes, religion, social values, and political trust. Round 11 collected data during 2023–2024. Particularly useful for examining how national identity relates to immigration, political attitudes, and social belonging. Covers participating European countries, although not every country in the requested list is included.

returned_title: European Social Survey: Round 10 (2020–2022)
justification: Cross-national individual-level survey containing questions on national and ethnic identity, attachment to Europe, immigration, social trust, religion, and human values. Data collection took place during the early 2020s, with timing varying by country. Suitable for investigating national identity during the COVID-19 period and comparing identity-related attitudes with subsequent ESS rounds.

returned_title: European Social Survey: Round 12 (2025/2026)
justification: Relevant for extending comparative research on European and national identity into the middle of the 2020s. The ESS core questionnaire includes measures related to national belonging, ethnic identification, social values, immigration, and political attitudes. The official data portal is the appropriate source for checking available Round 12 country datasets and releases. Availability should be verified because collection and publication schedules differ.

returned_title: European Values Study and World Values Survey: Joint EVS/WVS 2017–2022 Dataset
justification: One of the strongest resources for studying cultural and national identity across the requested countries. Combines European Values Study and World Values Survey observations into a harmonized international dataset. Includes questions on national pride, national belonging, religion, cultural values, immigration, trust, democracy, and attitudes toward society. The 2017–2022 collection period includes observations from the early 2020s, although many country surveys were conducted before 2020. Country-specific fieldwork dates should be checked.

returned_title: World Values Survey: Wave 7 (2017–2022) Cross-National Dataset
justification: International survey dataset covering cultural values, national identity, national pride, religion, social trust, political beliefs, and attitudes toward immigration. Includes European and neighboring countries relevant to the query. Particularly valuable for comparing cultural and national identity in European Union countries with countries such as Turkey, Serbia, and other participating states. Some observations fall within the 2020s, while others predate the decade.

returned_title: European Values Study 2017: Integrated Dataset, Including 2020–2021 Fieldwork
justification: Comprehensive European survey examining national identity, national pride, cultural traditions, religion, tolerance, immigration, social values, and political attitudes. Although designated the 2017 wave, fieldwork continued into the 2020s in certain countries, including Portugal in 2020 and Latvia in 2021. Also contains observations from many of the requested EU and Western Balkan countries collected during 2017–2019. Useful for longitudinal comparisons, provided the actual collection years are distinguished.

returned_title: European Values Study: Fifth Wave National Datasets
justification: Collection of national survey datasets investigating cultural values, national pride, social belonging, religion, tolerance, and identity. Particularly useful when country-level documentation or additional national variables are needed. Includes European Union countries and several Western Balkan and Eastern European countries, including Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Montenegro, North Macedonia, and Serbia. Fieldwork extends to 2021 for selected countries, but most surveys predate 2020.

returned_title: European Values Study: National Datasets and Documentation
justification: Official repository for accessing country-specific European Values Study datasets and harmonized cross-national data. Supports research on cultural identity, national belonging, national pride, religion, ethnicity, and values. Especially useful for locating individual country datasets and determining whether observations fall within the 2020s. Also provides the joint EVS/WVS 2017–2022 dataset.

returned_title: Eurostat: Participation in Cultural or Sport Activities in the Last 12 Months
justification: Official Eurostat dataset containing 2022 observations on participation in cultural and sporting activities. Includes breakdowns by country, age, sex, education, activity type, and frequency. Covers all 27 EU member states and selected additional European countries. Particularly relevant for examining cultural participation as a behavioral dimension of cultural identity. It does not directly measure subjective national identity, but complements survey-based identity indicators.

returned_title: Eurostat: Cultural Participation Statistics
justification: Official collection of European cultural statistics covering participation in cultural activities, reading, cultural institutions, cultural employment, and related indicators. Includes 2022 cultural participation data and additional observations from the 2020s. Useful for examining cultural engagement across EU member states and selected candidate countries, including some Western Balkan countries and Turkey. Provides contextual indicators for comparing cultural practices with national identity attitudes.

returned_title: Eurostat: EU Statistics on Income and Living Conditions, 2022 Cultural Participation Module
justification: Metadata and data-access reference for the 2022 EU-SILC cultural participation indicators. Covers participation in cultural activities, cultural events, and cultural sites. Geographic coverage includes EU member states and additional European countries, with 2022 data available for Montenegro, Albania, Serbia, and Turkey. Useful for analyzing differences in cultural participation across countries and demographic groups.

returned_title: Eurostat: Culture Statistics Database
justification: Official European statistical resource covering multiple cultural domains, including participation, employment, cultural goods, services, and household cultural expenditure. Contains datasets with observations from the 2020s. Valuable for studying the social and economic dimensions of cultural identity across the European Union and selected neighboring countries. Best used alongside opinion surveys to distinguish cultural behavior from subjective national identification.

returned_title: Eurobarometer Data Service: Standard and Special Eurobarometer Surveys
justification: Official GESIS resource for identifying the geographic coverage of Standard and Special Eurobarometer datasets. Useful for locating 2020s surveys related to European citizenship, national identity, cultural values, and European integration. Particularly relevant because some Eurobarometer waves cover countries outside the EU, including the United Kingdom, Turkey, Western Balkan countries, Moldova, and Georgia. Individual survey records should be consulted to establish exact coverage and question availability.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 2023: Cross-National Public Opinion Surveys
justification: GESIS provides access to Eurobarometer surveys conducted during 2023, including studies classified under cultural and national identity. Some 2023 surveys extend beyond the EU to the United Kingdom, Turkey, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia, Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, and Moldova. Particularly useful for comparative analysis of European identification, national belonging, citizenship, and political attitudes. This is a repository search landing page rather than a single dataset.

returned_title: World Values Survey: Integrated Cross-National Survey Data
justification: Official World Values Survey data documentation and access portal for comparative research on national identity and cultural values. Provides harmonized survey data for investigating national pride, ethnic belonging, religion, tolerance, immigration, and social trust. Useful for extending identity research beyond EU member states to participating countries in southeastern and eastern Europe. Researchers can select country observations collected during the 2020s.

returned_title: Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) Dataset – Democracy and Political Institutions, 2020–2025
justification: A comprehensive cross-national dataset measuring electoral democracy, liberal democracy, political participation, civil liberties, political corruption, and institutional accountability. Its country-year observations cover the 2020s and nearly all requested European countries, including EU members, Turkey, the Western Balkans, Moldova, and Georgia. Particularly valuable for comparing democratic development and political change across countries.

returned_title: International IDEA – Global State of Democracy Indices, 2020–2025
justification: Provides internationally comparable indicators of democratic performance, political representation, rights, rule of law, and political participation. The dataset includes European Union countries and non-EU countries such as Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Kosovo, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, Turkey, and the United Kingdom. Suitable for longitudinal analysis of democratic developments during the 2020s.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey (CHES) – 2024 European Political Party Positions
justification: Contains expert assessments of 279 political parties in 31 European countries, collected in 2024. Variables measure left-right ideology, European integration, populism, democracy, immigration, and policy positions. Covers all EU member states except Luxembourg, alongside Turkey and the United Kingdom, among other countries. Particularly useful for comparing political polarization and party ideology in the 2020s.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey – 2019 Candidate Countries Survey, Fielded in 2020
justification: Provides expert evaluations of 58 political parties in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia, and Serbia. Although labeled the 2019 Candidate Survey, the data were collected between July and September 2020. Includes political ideology, European integration, and policy positions. Especially relevant for Western Balkan countries that are not comprehensively represented in EU-focused political datasets.

returned_title: Manifesto Project Database – Political Party Manifestos and Election Programs
justification: Provides coded political party election manifestos, party policy positions, and electoral information across numerous European countries. Includes elections held during the 2020s and allows analysis of political priorities, ideological shifts, party competition, European integration, environmental policy, and immigration. Particularly useful for comparing party platforms across elections and countries.

returned_title: Manifesto Project Dataset – Version 2024a
justification: An identifiable release of the Manifesto Project's comparative party-preference dataset. Contains standardized coding of electoral programs for political parties across Europe, including elections from the early 2020s. Useful for reproducible research on ideological positioning, political competition, electoral platforms, and changes in party priorities.

returned_title: European Social Survey – Round 10, 2020–2022
justification: Provides individual-level survey data on political trust, political participation, voting behavior, satisfaction with democracy, institutional confidence, and social attitudes. Round 10 includes data collected during 2020–2022 from numerous European countries, including Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Lithuania, Slovakia, Slovenia, and others. Useful for comparing citizens' political attitudes during the COVID-19 period.

returned_title: European Social Survey – Round 11, 2023–2024
justification: Offers harmonized cross-national survey data on political attitudes, democratic satisfaction, institutional trust, political interest, electoral participation, and related social characteristics. Particularly relevant for studying political developments following the COVID-19 pandemic and comparing political behavior across participating European countries.

returned_title: European Commission – Eurobarometer Survey Database, 2020s
justification: Official European Union public-opinion survey repository covering all 27 EU member states, including Belgium, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Ireland, Greece, Spain, France, Croatia, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Hungary, Malta, the Netherlands, Austria, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Slovakia, Finland, Sweden, and Germany. Contains 2020s survey data on trust in government, democracy, European institutions, political priorities, and EU integration.

returned_title: European Parliament – Autumn 2025 Eurobarometer Survey
justification: Official European Parliament public-opinion survey conducted in November 2025 and published in February 2026. Covers all 27 EU member states and examines political priorities, citizens' expectations of European institutions, EU-related attitudes, and major policy concerns. Includes country-level results and downloadable survey documentation, making it valuable for contemporary comparative European politics research.

returned_title: European Parliament – 2024 European Election Results Dataset
justification: Official downloadable electoral statistics for the 2024 European Parliament elections across all 27 EU member states. Includes voter turnout, electoral results, political party performance, and distribution of parliamentary seats by national parties and European political groups. Particularly useful for studying voting behavior, Euroscepticism, political representation, and electoral change during the 2020s.

returned_title: European Election Studies – Electoral Behavior and Political Attitudes
justification: GESIS hosts European Election Studies research datasets, including materials associated with the 2024 European Parliament elections. Available studies cover European electoral behavior, party competition, political attitudes, and election manifestos. Geographic coverage includes numerous EU countries such as Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Latvia, Malta, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and Finland.

returned_title: International IDEA – Voter Turnout Database
justification: A comprehensive international election participation dataset containing parliamentary, presidential, and European Parliament election turnout statistics. Includes registered voters, voting-age population, total votes, invalid votes, and turnout percentages. Covers elections during the 2020s across EU countries and non-EU European states. Particularly suitable for comparing political participation and electoral engagement across the requested countries.

returned_title: World Bank – Worldwide Governance Indicators, 2020–2025
justification: Provides annual country-level indicators measuring voice and accountability, political stability, government effectiveness, regulatory quality, rule of law, and control of corruption. Includes the requested European countries and permits consistent comparisons of political institutions and governance performance during the 2020s. Particularly useful for analyzing political stability, institutional effectiveness, and governance quality.

returned_title: World Bank DataBank – Worldwide Governance Indicators
justification: Interactive database offering country-year governance statistics that can be filtered and exported for comparative political analysis. Supports cross-country comparisons of democratic accountability, corruption control, political stability, and government effectiveness throughout the 2020s. Useful for constructing comparative political indicators across EU countries, the Western Balkans, Turkey, Moldova, Georgia, and the United Kingdom.

returned_title: European Observatory of Political Trust – Political Trust and Democratic Participation Data
justification: Combines political trust information from multiple international survey programs with contextual political and institutional indicators. Topics include trust in political institutions, voter turnout, democracy, electoral systems, corruption, political fragmentation, and perceptions of electoral integrity. Useful for comparative European political research, although the temporal coverage of individual variables should be checked before restricting analysis to the 2020s.

returned_title: OSCE ODIHR – Election Observation Database and Election Reports, 2020s
justification: Official repository of election observation findings and election-related documentation from the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe. Covers elections during the 2020s in countries including Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Georgia, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Turkey, and other European states. Particularly useful for research on electoral integrity, political competition, campaign conditions, election administration, and democratic standards. Reports are primarily documentary rather than a single harmonized statistical dataset.

returned_title: World Values Survey – Wave 7, 2017–2022
justification: Cross-national individual-level survey dataset covering political trust, confidence in government, democratic values, political participation, ideological orientations, and attitudes toward political authority. Wave 7 includes surveys conducted between 2017 and 2022, making its observations collected in 2020–2022 relevant to the requested period. European country coverage varies, so participating countries and fieldwork dates must be checked before analysis.

returned_title: World Values Survey – Data and Documentation Portal
justification: Official repository providing cross-national survey datasets, questionnaires, methodological documentation, and country-specific files. Supports research on political legitimacy, democracy, civic participation, political institutions, national identity, and public attitudes. Relevant for analyzing early-2020s political values in participating European countries and comparing them with previous survey waves.

returned_title: European National Parliamentary Elections Dataset – Harmonized Subnational Election Results, 1983–2025
justification: Research dataset containing national parliamentary election results for 32 European countries, with coverage extending through 2025. Harmonizes election outcomes across multiple territorial aggregation levels, including NUTS regions. Includes post-2020 elections and supports geographical analysis of party voting patterns, regional political differences, and changes in electoral support. Country coverage and the availability of fine-grained geographic results vary.

returned_title: Chapel Hill Expert Survey – European Political Party Position Trends, 1999–2024
justification: Longitudinal expert-survey data tracking European political parties' ideological positions and policy preferences across multiple survey waves, including 2024. Enables comparison of contemporary political developments with earlier periods. Particularly useful for studying changes in party ideology, European integration, nationalism, populism, and political polarization among European democracies.

returned_title: International IDEA – Global State of Democracy Indices, Version 10 (2026)
justification: Official documentation for the 2026 release of International IDEA's democracy indices, covering democratic developments through 2025. Describes the dataset's political indicators, classifications, and measurement framework. Relevant for systematic comparative analysis of political representation, rights, institutional checks, and democratic performance across the requested European countries, including Kosovo, Moldova, Georgia, and Western Balkan states.

returned_title: International IDEA – Global State of Democracy Indices Data and Methodology
justification: Official resource explaining access to International IDEA's comparative democracy indicators and their interpretation. The underlying dataset provides country-level measures of democratic development across European states during the 2020s. Useful for identifying relevant variables, understanding country coverage, and conducting reproducible comparisons of political institutions and democratic performance.

returned_title: United Nations General Assembly Voting Data (1946–2026)
justification: Official United Nations dataset containing recorded votes on General Assembly resolutions, including votes during the 2020s. Covers nearly all requested countries, including EU member states, the United Kingdom, Turkey, Western Balkan states, Moldova, and Georgia that are UN members. Particularly useful for studying foreign policy alignment, international cooperation, diplomatic disagreements, and voting behavior within international organizations. The October 2026 version includes resolutions through September 17, 2026. Kosovo is not represented as a separate UN member.

returned_title: Standard Eurobarometer 105 – Spring 2026
justification: European Commission survey dataset measuring public attitudes toward the European Union, EU institutions, European integration, and international political developments. Provides comparable survey results for all 27 EU member states, with additional coverage of selected non-EU European countries. Particularly relevant for examining public trust in international organizations, perceptions of EU membership, and attitudes toward international crises in 2026.

returned_title: Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) Dataset, Version 16 (2026)
justification: Comprehensive country-year dataset covering democratic institutions, political accountability, civil society, electoral competition, political participation, and governance. Includes observations for the 2020s across the requested European countries. Useful for comparative research on institutional development, international democracy promotion, European integration, and political transformations. Particularly valuable for comparing EU member states with EU accession candidates.

returned_title: V-Dem Historical Dataset Archive
justification: Repository of historical V-Dem dataset releases, including datasets published during the 2020s. Enables researchers to compare political institutions and democratic developments across European countries using consistent country-year indicators. Useful for studying democratic backsliding, institutional reforms, political freedoms, and changes in governance associated with international integration.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS) – Round 10 and Round 11
justification: Cross-national survey microdata covering political trust, attitudes toward European institutions, trust in the United Nations, political participation, national identity, immigration, and democratic values. Researchers can select participating countries, survey rounds, and variables to construct comparable datasets on perceptions of international politics and organizations. Country participation varies by round.

returned_title: World Values Survey – Wave 7 (2017–2022)
justification: International survey dataset examining political values, institutional confidence, national identity, democratic legitimacy, and attitudes toward international organizations. Includes observations from the early 2020s and covers a selection of the requested European countries. Particularly suitable for studying public confidence in the United Nations, European institutions, international cooperation, and democratic governance. Not all requested countries participated.

returned_title: World Values Survey – Longitudinal Dataset (1981–2022)
justification: Harmonized longitudinal survey dataset containing political and social attitudes across multiple survey waves, including observations from the early 2020s. Provides measures of political trust, confidence in international institutions, democratic attitudes, and national identity. Useful for examining whether attitudes toward international organizations changed between earlier decades and the 2020s in participating European countries.

returned_title: World Values Survey – Wave 7 Country-Level Data and Documentation
justification: Official repository for country-specific survey files, questionnaires, and documentation from World Values Survey Wave 7. Researchers can identify participating European countries and extract variables related to political institutions, international organizations, national identity, geopolitical attitudes, and democratic legitimacy. Useful for constructing country comparisons covering the beginning of the 2020s.

returned_title: Harmonized Eurobarometer 2004–2021, Version 3.0.0
justification: Harmonized survey dataset combining 35 Standard Eurobarometer surveys and more than 140 variables concerning EU policies, European identity, institutional trust, political attitudes, and European integration. Particularly useful for comparing public opinion about European institutions across EU member states and examining changes associated with Brexit and European political developments.

returned_title: Eurostat – International Cooperation Database
justification: Official European statistical database providing access to harmonized indicators for EU member states, enlargement countries, and European Neighbourhood Policy countries. Relevant geographical coverage includes the requested EU countries and several non-EU states, including Western Balkan countries, Turkey, Moldova, and Georgia. Useful for examining the economic, demographic, and institutional context of international cooperation and European integration during the 2020s. Specific dataset selection is required.

returned_title: Eurostat – Enlargement Countries Statistical Overview
justification: Official Eurostat statistical collection covering Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, Turkey, and Kosovo. Provides comparative indicators relevant to EU enlargement, economic integration, and institutional development. Especially useful for analyzing the international political context of European Union accession during the 2020s. This is a statistical overview with links to underlying data rather than a single downloadable dataset.

returned_title: Eurostat – Enlargement and International Cooperation Statistics
justification: European Commission statistical resource focused on countries participating in the EU enlargement process. Covers Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia, Turkey, and Kosovo. Useful for identifying comparable statistical datasets relevant to European integration, accession negotiations, and institutional convergence during the 2020s. Provides access to enlargement-related statistical resources rather than a single political dataset.

returned_title: UN General Assembly and Security Council Voting Data – UNIndex
justification: Structured access to United Nations General Assembly and Security Council voting records, with country, voting-position, and date filters. The API supports country-specific extraction and comparative analysis.

returned_title: Correlates of War – Intergovernmental Organizations Dataset
justification: Historical dataset documenting state membership in intergovernmental organizations and shared organizational memberships between countries. returned_title: Central Statistics Office Ireland – Trust Survey 2025: International Comparisons
justification: Official statistical publication containing internationally comparable survey results on public trust in institutions, including international organizations such as the United Nations. Geographic coverage is limited to surveyed countries rather than the complete requested list.

returned_title: Central Statistics Office Ireland – Trust in International Organisations (TRA312)
justification: Official statistical dataset containing internationally comparable measures of trust in international organizations. Allows researchers to compare Ireland with other participating countries and investigate variation in public confidence in organizations such as the United Nations.

returned_title: Eurostat – European Countries Comparative Statistical Dataset (tin00127)
justification: Official Eurostat dataset with observations extending through the 2020s and geographic coverage that includes EU member states, the United Kingdom, Turkey, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Albania, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Kosovo. Its subject matter is not directly international politics, so it should be combined with political or institutional datasets.

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS) Round 10, 2020–2022

returned_title: European Social Survey (ESS) Round 11, 2023–2024

The data can be compared with Round 10 to investigate changes over time.

returned_title: European Parliament Election Study 2024 – Voter Study

Includes information about electoral choices, political preferences, perceptions of EU institutions, and evaluations of political representation. Especially appropriate for research on European electoral behaviour in 2024.

returned_title: Comparative Study of Electoral Systems (CSES) Module 6: Representative Democracy Under Pressure, 2021–2026
justification: International comparative election survey specifically designed to investigate political behaviour, democratic attitudes, electoral participation, and political representation. The November 17, 2026 advance release includes relevant election studies from Austria, Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, Hungary, Lithuania, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, and the United Kingdom, among others. Particularly useful for comparing EU and non-EU European democracies.

returned_title: Comparative Study of Electoral Systems (CSES) Module 5: Democracy Divided? 2016–2021
justification: Cross-national electoral survey examining voting behaviour, political participation, party preferences, political elites, populist attitudes, and perceptions of social and political divisions. Although the module begins before 2020, its later observations provide relevant evidence about political attitudes and electoral behaviour during the early 2020s. Useful for examining relationships between political distrust, populism, and electoral choices.

returned_title: Standard and Special Eurobarometer Surveys, 2020–2026
justification: An extensive collection of harmonized public opinion surveys conducted across European Union member states. Particularly valuable because it covers all 27 EU countries in the query and provides downloadable individual-level survey data.

returned_title: Eurobarometer 101.3, April–May 2024
justification: A harmonized Eurobarometer survey conducted in April and May 2024. Relevant for studying attitudes toward European institutions, public policy, and political developments. The dataset is archived by GESIS and can be used alongside other Eurobarometer waves to examine changes in political attitudes across the EU during the 2020s.

returned_title: Standard Eurobarometer 104, Autumn 2025

Particularly useful for analyzing public attitudes during 2025 and comparing them with previous Eurobarometer surveys conducted since 2020.

returned_title: European Parliament Eurobarometer, Autumn 2025
justification: A European Parliament public opinion survey examining attitudes toward EU membership, European political institutions, security, international conflicts, disinformation, and European cooperation. Provides country-level comparisons across the 27 EU member states. Relevant for investigating support for European integration, political priorities, and perceptions of democratic representation during the 2020s.

returned_title: European Values Study and World Values Survey: Joint EVS/WVS Dataset, 2017–2022
justification: A harmonized international dataset combining European Values Study and World Values Survey observations. returned_title: World Values Survey Wave 7, 2017–2022

returned_title: World Values Survey Longitudinal Dataset, 1981–2022

returned_title: Integrated Values Surveys and European Values Study Data Collections

returned_title: ParlGov – Parliaments and Governments Database
justification: Provides structured information about national elections, political parties, cabinet compositions, government coalitions, and parliamentary institutions. returned_title: Representative Democracy Data Archive (REPDEM) – Basic and Election Datasets, Version 2026

returned_title: Political Parties, Presidents, Elections, and Governments (PPEG) Database
justification: A comparative political dataset covering 73 countries between 1945 and October 2025. returned_title: Database of Political Institutions (DPI) 2023

returned_title: International IDEA – Global State of Democracy Indices, Version 10 (2026)
justification: Provides cross-national indicators of democratic performance, political representation, electoral participation, civil liberties, rule of law, and institutional accountability. returned_title: World Bank – Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI)
